meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以搜索之前所有对话中保存的记忆，找到过去讨论过的问题、修复过的 bug 或做过的功能。它会先列出摘要，再让你挑选感兴趣的条目，最后才获取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问“我们之前解决过这个问题吗？”、“上次怎么做 X 的？”或需要回顾之前会话的工作时触发。

say.text: 我们之前解决过这个 bug 吗？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关记忆并给出摘要。

say.text: 上次怎么修复认证令牌过期的？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关记录并展示上下文。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周做了什么。
say.note: Claude 会按日期搜索并列出结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the persistent memory database from all past sessions to find previously discussed issues, fixed bugs, or implemented features. It first returns a summary index, lets you pick relevant items, then fetches full details only for those selected.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g., "Did we already solve this?", "How did we do X last time?", or need work from past sessions.

say_en.text: Did we already fix this bug?
say_en.note: Claude will search memory and return a summary.

say_en.text: How did we fix the auth token expiration last time?
say_en.note: Claude will search and show context.

say_en.text: What did we do last week?
say_en.note: Claude will search by date and list results.
